title: Lettings agent receives suspended sentence for Covid loan fraud
summary:
A West Midlands property developer and lettings agent has received a 22-month suspended prison sentence after fraudulently obtaining Covid-19 business support loans totalling £125,000. Harjinder Singh was also banned from acting as a company director for seven years.

title: Avamore funds £3.3m development with highway works
summary:
Avamore Capital has provided £3.3 million in development finance for a six-unit residential scheme that includes substantial highway infrastructure work. The 18-month facility marks the lender's first transaction with a newly formed borrower partnership.

title: Oxford HMO scheme secures £3m bridge-to-let funding
summary:
A 21-bedroom house in multiple occupation (HMO) scheme on Iffley Road in Oxford has secured £3.05 million in bridge-to-let financing from specialist lender Aspen. The funding package, structured at 80% loan-to-value on day one, includes an initial advance of £2.05 million to refinance the existing purchase loan and continue construction works.

title: TouchRight targets CRM partnerships after Alto integration
summary:
Property inspection platform TouchRight is pursuing additional CRM integrations following the completion of its connection with Alto's system. The company has also launched AI-powered reporting functionality one year after director Miriam Roth acquired the business from Plentific.

title: Private tenants spend 36% of income on rent, data shows
summary:
Private tenants in England are spending approximately 36% of their household income on rent, according to new analysis by Generation Rent and the Renters' Reform Coalition. The data reveals significant regional variations, with Kensington and Chelsea showing the highest rental burden.

title: 44% of UK homes listed for sale fail to find buyers
summary:
Nearly half of UK homes listed for sale over the past three years did not complete a transaction, according to new data from property portal Zoopla, with pricing strategies identified as a primary factor in failed sales. The analysis found that 44% of properties listed between 2023 and 2026 remained unsold.

title: Chartwell Noble expands in Worcestershire market
summary:
Chartwell Noble has appointed Nicholas Kendrick as a Partner Agent to expand its operations in Worcestershire's country house market. The move follows the company's 129% year-on-year growth over the past 12 months.

title: Burnham’s housing policies face scrutiny amid leadership race
summary:
Andy Burnham's housing record as Mayor of Manchester faces increased scrutiny as he emerges as a leading contender for Prime Minister. His policies include a £40 billion council housebuilding programme and stricter rental sector enforcement.

title: OneDome reports 394% revenue growth in Q1 2026
summary:
Homebuying platform OneDome has reported first-quarter revenue of £15.3 million, representing a 394% increase from £3.1 million in the same period last year. The growth was attributed to expansion of the firm's national broker network and organic growth.

title: Public confidence in Labour housing policy drops to 17%
summary:
Public confidence in the Labour government's handling of housing policy has fallen to 17%, down four percentage points from May 2025, according to new polling conducted by Ipsos. The figures highlight the challenges facing ministers as the government works towards its target of delivering 1.5 million new homes during the current parliament.
